mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM point_history WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT point_id AS pointId, user_id AS userId, amount AS amount, type AS type, description AS description, created_at AS createdAt FROM point_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY point_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO point_history (user_id, amount, type, description) VALUES (#{userId}, #{amount}, #{type}, #{description})
